   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 2, 2026 - Sep 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Landorous_, Sep 2, 2026, 1/5: "This whole event is a glitchy mess. I can’t imagine how bad the movie will be. This applies to all."
            2. _anonymousical_, Sep 2, 2026, 1/5: "trying to charge me almost $40 after i deleted the app for a plan i never chose and now i can’t even download any apps until i pay for the yearly plan for a useless and pointless app just so i can download other apps. 1 star all the way. never has had this issue before until one. if i can give a zero rating i would. useless and money hungry people and app"
            3. _HappyBirdies4_, Sep 1, 2026, 2/5: "Very cute and fun app that allows you to set goals for a variety of life situations and find what motivates you to keep growing or find joy in your life. It helps people, and that means a lot in today’s world. However, this summer has been about serving a younger constituency very clearly. There are two monthly adventures focused on movies for tweens, and the month in between those two was focused on young gamers. They’ve also changed the rewards to limit the colors and selection that you have. Well that might seem like a minor part of the app, those rewards are actually important for neurodivergent people. When it’s a bunch of stuff that has no relevance to my life and doesn’t even give me the option to choose colors that might let it fit into my life or my interests, it’s hard to use the rewards as motivation. And having three of these out of four months this summer or three of three months I don’t remember, which makes it really difficult to keep wanting to use the app when it’s not geared towards a general audience and letting people have the selection that they’ve had before. If you count the wicked month, this has been most of this year that they focused on movies or things for people under age 25. What’s worse is they still have not fixed the glitch that makes the current adventure reload constantly while you’re using the app so you really don’t have a way to opt out of this month’s movie adventure and you can barely use the app for the tools that you need during the day because it keeps asking you to join that adventure and is stuck in a loop."
